claim_text_or_paraphrase: The configurator performs executive control and pre-configures perception, world model, cost, and actor for the task.
The perception module estimates the current state of the world.
The world model estimates missing state information and predicts plausible future states, including outcomes of actor-proposed action sequences.
The short-term memory module stores relevant past, current, and future world states together with intrinsic-cost values.
The cost module computes energy from intrinsic cost and a trainable critic that estimates future intrinsic energies.
The actor module proposes action sequences, evaluates them through the world model and cost, and outputs an optimized action sequence.
